surface.title: Scheduling
surface.description: Share a booking link, review requests, and keep your open times current.

booking-link.title: Your booking link
booking-link.body: Use this placeholder link until the public page is connected.
booking-link.share-text: Pick a time that works for you.
booking-link.trust: Clients only see your open times, never your calendar details.

upcoming.title: Upcoming and requests
upcoming.body: Confirmed meetings stay quiet. Pending requests ask for a clear yes or no.
upcoming.empty-title: Share your link to start taking bookings.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: Choose the weekdays and hours clients can book.

meeting-types.title: Meeting types
meeting-types.body: Keep the list short so clients choose quickly.
meeting-types.panel-body: Set the length and breathing room before or after the meeting.

preview.title: Next open slots
preview.body: This preview updates from your hours, buffers, and current requests.
preview.empty: No open slots in the current window.
